text:
Maya R.: Taking over primary now for EU night shift. Quick context: we saw intermittent p99 spikes on generation (~1.8s -> 4s) earlier and a couple of KV-cache misses that correlated with degraded tail latency. Leaving a short checklist and runbook links before I log off at 0200 UTC.

Sam L.: thanks — I'll stay secondary. any known customer impact?

Maya R.: minimal customer impact so far, a handful of requests hitting longer tail but no error escalations. A few internal alerts from perf-tracker. I ran the kvcache-health check and saw hot-shards 2 & 5 thrashing.

Devon K.: tagging in the incident summary from OpsBot:
OpsBot: [summary] 2026-02-18 22:10 UTC - perf-anomaly detected on /v1/generate, p95 normal, p99 elevated. Related metrics: kvcache.miss_rate=0.23, queue.latency.p99=3.9s. No 5xx.

Maya R.: Action plan I left:
- If p99 > 3s for more than 5 minutes, move traffic to fallback model variant (slice-quant-1) via routing policy.
- If kvcache miss_rate > 0.2 on >1 shard, restart kvcache worker on affected nodes (see runbook).
- Disable batcher autoscale surge for 10m if we observe queue spikes (prevents over-batching).
- Open a quick issue for eval-team with prompt set that repros the worst tail.

Priya S.: Can you paste the runbook link and the exact restart command? doing a quick handover note.

Maya R.: Runbooks:
- KV cache stall: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvcache-stall
- Model fallback & routing: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallback-routing
- Batcher autoscale ops: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/batcher-autoscale

Restart command I used (run as infra-admin):
```
ssh infra-admin@10.34.2.X
sudo systemctl restart redwood-kvcache-worker.service --node=shard-2
```
If you're using the k8s wrapper: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart ds/kvcache-worker --selector=shard=2`

Sam L.: noted. I'll keep an eye on shard 2 & 5. Who's on-call for APAC late window (0200-0400 UTC)? I think we have a coverage gap if something spikes.

Devon K.: APAC on-call is out between 0200-0400 UTC today (holiday rotation). I can be on standby until 0300, but after that it's just primary on pagers. Logging it in the handover note.

Maya R.: ok marking the gap: APAC gap 0300-0400 UTC. If anything pages after 0300, prioritize: 1) confirm if it's region-specific (check region header), 2) apply model fallback for that region, 3) escalate to infra if kvcache restart needed.

IncidentBot: Page created -> #pager: oncall-primary, incident-id: INC-20260218-137. Pager condition: p99_generation > 3s sustained for 5m.

Sam L.: If pager fires, quick triage checklist I suggest (keeps decisions short):
1) Check /metrics/kvcache for miss_rate and load per shard.
2) If miss_rate > 0.25 restart worker on affected shard(s).
3) If queue.latency.p99 > 5s and miss_rate low -> likely serving congestion: route to slice-quant-1 or slab-2.
4) If 5xx appear, open a P0 and run the rollback playbook.

Priya S.: adding a small snippet for the routing toggle we use in Console (copy/paste):
```json
{
  "route": "eu-west-1",
  "policy": "fallback",
  "target_model": "slice-quant-1",
  "ttl": 600
}
```
Run via: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @route.json https://api.redwood.io/v1/routing/toggle`

Maya R.: Also leaving quick mitigation tips for next shift:
- Avoid full kvcache restarts unless miss_rate > 0.2 on >2 nodes; prefer rolling restart on single shard first.
- If you restart a kvcache worker, watch for a small spike in upstream latency for ~30s as warm cache repopulates.
- If you need to throttle, set the per-route qps cap to 80% of normal for 5m (`console -> routes -> edit -> qps`)

Devon K.: small note: we saw one client (internal eval harness) hammering routes with long contexts which amplified kv misses. If you see a particular API key spiking, block it for 10m and open a dev ticket.

Sam L.: copying the most important links into the oncall bookmark:
- kvcache-stall runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvcache-stall
- routing fallback: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallback-routing
- emergency rollback: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-playbook
- incident dashboard: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260218-137

Maya R.: final note before I log: primary -> Maya R. until 0200 UTC, secondary -> Sam L. Devon K. standby until 0300. APAC gap flagged 0300-0400. If anything pages, follow Sam's checklist first, then escalate to infra. I'll leave a short post-incident note in the ticket if anything changes. :thumbsup:

Sam L.: thanks Maya — I have the checklist. I'll ping if the pager hits.

Maya R.: signing off 22:35 UTC — good handoff.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-20260218-137 status -> monitoring (no P0 opened).
